item.title: Lynn E. Feller
item.description: Lynn E. Feller, 84, Huntington, formerly of Whitley County and North Webster, died at 7:45 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 18, 2025, at Markle Health & Rehabilitation. He was born April 26, 1941, in Fort Wayne. On July 16, 1960, he married Dortha E. "Dottie" Schrader, who survives. He also is survived by his sons, Rod (Tina)...

Neva M. Wank
item.description: Neva Marie Heintz Wank, 65, Winamac, died Tuesday, Nov. 18, 2025, at home. She was born Jan. 3, 1960. Rans Funeral Homes & Crematory, Winamac, is handling arrangements.

item.title: Plymouth Man Arrested for Allegedly Battering Pregnant Woman
item.description: A Plymouth man was arrested for alleged battery of a pregnant woman.

item.title: Rep. David Abbott Tells Syracuse Town Council He Supports CAP Grant
item.description: State Rep. David Abbott stopped by the Syracuse Town Council during its regular meeting Tuesday night, Nov. 18, to lend support for the Community Amenities Program grant application the town is working on.

item.title: Park Award Presented, Land Donated At Syracuse Town Council Meeting
item.description: The Syracuse Town Council started its regular monthly meeting on a high note Tuesday night, Nov. 18.

item.title: Warsaw Man Arrested After Allegedly Committing Sex Crimes Against Child
item.description: A Warsaw man was recently arrested for allegedly filming videos of him having sex with a teenager.

item.title: Indiana Legislative Leaders Dodge Discussing Redistricting Pressure
item.description: Republican Indiana legislative leaders avoided taking questions Monday about the political pressure they are facing from President Donald Trump over congressional redistricting, while the governor accused GOP senators of “hiding behind closed doors.”

item.title: Wawasee Fine Art Gallery celebrates its anniversary with a holiday community event
item.description: The Wawasee Fine Art Gallery announces its first anniversary celebration, marking one year of creativity, community and culture in the heart of Syracuse.
